blurb: Guests rent a 2022 Bennington 20' SVLSP pontoon boat powered by a Yamaha 90 horsepower engine. Rentals include options for 4, 6, or 8 hours, or custom bookings with management approval. Customers meet at the dock 30 minutes before their rental for a briefing and receive a map with designated boating areas and local points of interest.
extraNote: $200 refundable deposit required for custom bookings · Deposit refunded after return inspection and post trip forms completion · Boat must be returned by 10:00 pm · If boat returned after 5pm and gas pump closed, management refuels and deducts cost from deposit · Renters must sign e-waivers emailed after booking · Dock at marina, meet 30 minutes before rental time
